entities.name: James Stanhope, 1st Earl Stanhope
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: James Stanhope, 1st Earl Stanhope, was a British Army officer and Whig politician who effectively served as Chief Minister between 1717 and 1721. He was also the last Chancellor of the Exchequer to sit in the House of Lords.
